bullets.text: In Uthukottai, heavy rain submerged 400 acres of paddy crops due to road work, and the office should monitor relief efforts.
Near Sholavaram in Thiruvallur district, police detained two lorry drivers for murdering a colleague during a dispute.
On Velachery Main Road, water-filled potholes threaten motorists, and the office should urge immediate road repairs.
In Poonamallee, angry passengers protested after waiting two hours for a government bus, and transport officials should review bus schedules.
In Thiruvallur district, three members of the same family passed away consecutively, causing deep local sorrow.

stories.title: Thiruvallur || damaged crops || Uthukottai
takeaways: Heavy rains in Ponthavakkam and surrounding areas near Uthukottai submerged 400 acres of paddy crops.
District administration officials must assess the agricultural damage and disburse relief to affected farmers.

stories.title: Missing lorry driver beaten to death and buried near Sholavaram, two held
takeaways: A missing lorry driver was beaten to death and buried in Sholavaram within Tiruvallur district.
Two suspects have been detained by local police following a drunken altercation.

stories.title: Water-filled potholes on Velachery Main Road pose threat to motorists
takeaways: Water-filled potholes on Velachery Main Road near the Medavakkam flyover threaten two-wheeler riders.
Immediate civic intervention is required to repair the damaged road stretch before fatal accidents occur.
